phase: Phase S5: Gate rules and CI
summary: Security and CI risk review of 3ff2f6ea..31d8b96c found no blocking finding. The deploy job left ci.yml with no secret, permission, trigger, or deploy path moved elsewhere. cloudflare-deploy.yml is byte-identical and keeps workflow_dispatch, environment production, and both Cloudflare secrets. The format-check step adds no action and no PR-input interpolation. Root scripts add no untrusted command, network call, dependency, or lockfile change. Guardrails and npm audit figures are intact.
evidence: Provenance: git rev-parse HEAD returns 31d8b96cf44d0f94e6494a32985949ef5e0b80d2, which equals the immutable audited HEAD. role_base_sha equals that HEAD. phase_base_sha 3ff2f6ea is an ancestor of HEAD (confirmed in jr-green-s5-d04944f4.log line 3).

Security applicability: test-strategy.md line 1929 marks Security review (Review B) as applicable for S5 because the phase removes the deploy job from ci.yml. The actual diff changes .github/workflows/ci.yml, so the audit is applicable, not not_applicable.

D7 deploy removal: git diff of ci.yml shows the 'Phase 6: Deploy' comment and the whole deploy job deleted. That deleted job held environment production, cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3, secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, and command deploy --config wrangler.jsonc.

Deploy path preserved: git rev-parse of the cloudflare-deploy.yml blob gives 0edfc43556dfe73a7b9776863c4e7af181a57e71 at both the phase base and the audited HEAD. The file is byte-identical. It keeps on.workflow_dispatch, job deploy-production, environment production, both Cloudflare secrets, and wrangler-action@v3 (cloudflare-deploy.yml lines 1-60).

No path moved: git diff --name-only over .github/ lists only ci.yml. The ci.yml file after the change has no secrets.* reference, no wrangler line, no environment: production, and no permissions: block. The file before the change had the same triggers (push master/main, pull_request, workflow_dispatch), no permissions: block, and its only secrets.* lines were inside the deleted deploy job.

No pull_request_target trigger and no top-level permissions: block appear in any workflow at HEAD (grep -rnE 'pull_request_target|^permissions:' .github/workflows/ returns no hit). node scripts/validate-ci.mjs exits 0 and reports that cloudflare-deploy.yml has deployment gating (workflow_dispatch/staging/environment).

f9e8a879 format-check step: the ci.yml diff adds only '- name: Run format check', 'run: npm run format:check', and 'env: CI: true' inside boundary-check. No new uses: line appears. All uses: entries stay actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4. The run line holds no ${{ }} interpolation, so PR input cannot inject script text.

Root package.json script changes: git diff shows lint and typecheck switch from scripts/architecture/run-workspace-quality.mjs to 'npm run <cap> --workspaces --if-present', and six root ws:*:typecheck fallbacks switch from 'npx tsc --noEmit --project ...' to 'npm run typecheck --prefix ...'. Each command runs a fixed local npm script. No command consumes user input, adds a network call, or adds a dependency.
No lockfile change: git diff over package-lock.json and over any path matching *lock* is empty. No dependency or lock entry changed in the range.

Guardrails intact: the AGENTS.md diff changes only the TDD line and the typecheck line. The Deploys and cloud cleanup rule (lines 138-142), the Secrets rule (lines 144-146), and the Paid spend rule (line 147) stay verbatim. The measure/workflow.md diff changes only the Before Committing quality-gate lines and adds format and typecheck commands. The '- [ ] No security vulnerabilities introduced' gate stays.

No secret in added lines: git diff --unified=0 piped through a grep for secret, token, api_key, password, credential, private_key, CLOUDFLARE, AKIA, sk-, ghp_, and bearer finds only documentation references to cloudflare-deploy.yml and Review B notes. No secret value, token, or key was added. The secrets.CLOUDFLARE_* references were in deleted lines.

npm audit: gates/s5/audit.txt line 1 and s5-gate-checks-all.log line 1 both record 'critical=0 high=9 moderate=7 low=5'. This equals the S3 and S4 values (oxc-evidence.md lines 200 and 238) and is below the merged-tree baseline high=11 (oxc-evidence.md line 165). No new high severity finding appears.

A2 consent-blind publish gate is not applicable: the range changes no application runtime, no status flip from draft to published, and no consent or anonymization artifact. No named subject is published by any added line.

A6 registry overstatement is not applicable: git diff --name-only over measure/tracks.md is empty. The range makes no registry security-state claim, so no 'resolved' claim needs an adversarial green proof.

Six generated files (four apps/*/.next/types/routes.d.ts, apps/bus-math-v2/lib/workbooks-manifest.json, measure/generated/routes.md) remain unstaged. The audit wrote no production code, test, plan, or registry file.
